title: The Discriminant Resolvent of the A5-Cubic Pencil
description: The nonstandard A5-invariant pencil of cubic threefolds carries a five-sheet packet of stable principal gluing kernels: three rational and two golden. This paper identifies the packet with the two proper quotients of the ordered two-torsion torsor on the actual elliptic norm axis. The rational triple is the root cover, and the golden pair is its sign, or discriminant, cover. For the signed cubic parameter t and T = 81t^2, the norm-axis period is j = (T+27)(T+3)^3/T; the root and sign resolvents are X_0(6) and r^2 = T, and their common Galois closure belongs to Gamma_0(3) intersect Gamma(2). Pullback to the signed cubic line splits the sign cover and turns the root cover into a cyclic A3 splitting cover, ramified exactly over the fibres with five A2-points. The paper separates the modular cusps from the other cubic degenerations and identifies the chordal hyperelliptic limit with an elliptic fifth power at the same modular value.
